title: 12 Best Tokyo's Jazz Bars for an Unforgettable Night
description: Discover Tokyo's best jazz bars, from legendary live venues to intimate audiophile havens. Find top picks for every budget and experience, with insider tips.

places.name: Blue Note Tokyo
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Enjoy a craft cocktail from their extensive bar list alongside their seasonal fine dining menu. The Japanese Wagyu beef is often a standout.

places.name: Pit Inn
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic whiskey highball or a local beer. The focus here is purely on the music.

places.name: Bar Martha
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A perfectly crafted whisky or a gin and tonic. Let the bartender guide you based on your preference.

places.name: Shinjuku Jazz Spot J
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Grab a beer or a simple cocktail. Their sake selection is also surprisingly good for a jazz bar.

places.name: Jazz Bar DUG
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Order a classic old fashioned or a fine Japanese whisky on the rocks. Their highballs are also perfectly made.

places.name: Sometime
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Enjoy one of their daily specials from the kitchen, often Western-inspired comfort food, along with a glass of wine or a beer.

places.name: Ginza Swan
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A beautifully presented cocktail, perhaps a classic martini, or a glass of fine Japanese whisky.

places.name: Body & Soul
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their simple bar fare and drinks are solid. Focus on the music, perhaps a sake or a shochu highball.

places.name: Little MANHATTAN
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Trust the master bartender. Their classic cocktails are impeccable, especially the martinis and Manhattans.

places.name: Intro
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A craft beer from their rotating selection or a simple highball. They also have some light snacks.

places.name: Alfie
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Choose from their selection of sake or shochu, or a well-made whisky on the rocks.

places.name: Naru
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their Western-style dishes, like pasta or grilled items, are popular. Pair it with a wine or a beer while enjoying the show.
